publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.4.3 lets Run Edit Run read an installation's cutover status: a signed cutover-status request returns each alert destination's host, its deliveries sent and accepted since a given time, and the monitors and incidents created since then (counts, ids and hosts only; it writes nothing, and without a valid grant it refuses). The Business import door is now Base's door byte for byte at rer 0.2.71, so undo keeps a monitor edited or enabled since the import and the door gains archive and restore-check. UptimeRobot exports that Run Edit Run has cleaned of credentials now import, URLs with ordinary query parameters such as ?keyword= import, and erasing a monitor withdraws every Business archive that names it. The console now refreshes in place: open sections, form entries and the scroll position stay put while new results arrive. One additive migration (0056_import_door_archive.sql), no new required settings, and @runeditrun/rer is pinned to exactly 0.2.71. Back up before upgrading; monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are kept, and archives from 0.4.2 restore. Known issue: a response body over 64 KiB still fails the check, so monitor a smaller page such as a health endpoint. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
